$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. Both are launched from the checkout, never from the network,
so the version an assistant consults is the version this workspace pins (P4).
angular-cli: the Angular CLI's own MCP server (`ng mcp`), from the catalog-pinned
@angular/cli in node_modules. Run `pnpm install` first or it will not start.
It exposes get_best_practices, search_documentation, ai_tutor, list_projects,
onpush_zoneless_migration, run_target and the devserver_* trio. From the repo root it
discovers all five angular.json workspaces (packages/angulux, apps/showcase, apps/verify, ...).
Known warning: it cannot resolve the framework version because the catalog: protocol is
not a semver comparator. Documentation lookups still work; only version-targeting is blind.
Pass --read-only to drop run_target and devserver_start/stop.
angulux: this repo's own server, answering from corpus/corpus.json. No model has seen
